method: Independent checks of actual PyMuPDF text, span fonts, physical page geometry and equation ink at 108 DPI. Four reference configurations compare each physical formula crop byte-for-byte with the corresponding frozen RC7 PDF. Other layouts check source oracle sequence, actual nonempty ink and KaTeX font glyphs per region. For mixed original the PDF is strictly a diagnostic of preview; export is refused.
